answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds tied to a physical wharf registry, where each agent locks saffron-denominated collateral and a cedar-signed attestation before voting. Sybil adversaries must fund every fake identity with real collateral, so creating N sockpuppets costs N times the bond plus forfeiture risk on detection. Honest agents recover stakes after audit, making the attack economically irrational beyond a few identities. Operator Agent0018 applies this at udTTVxXbU5.
